# Self-authored media fixtures

`red.jpg` and `red.jp2` encode the same 4 × 4 RGB image, all pixels `(255, 0, 0)`.
The PNG source was constructed from PNG IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks and Node zlib;
macOS `/usr/bin/sips -s format jpeg` and `-s format jp2` encoded the two files.
These contain no third-party artwork, document or personal data and are covered
by this repository's Apache-2.0 license.

SHA-256:

- `red.jpg`: `3ec7d5ed3fe0506edcba7950596e311e719c1b265940f53abe7dd42a9ccf500a`
- `red.jp2`: `54b17d7ff376d8226e2258425c546749a5a25b7b008c4c51c3fd341d8c40bacc`

PDF and DOCX source fixtures are generated by `../media-parser-data.ts`.
